title: QUENCH: Measuring the gap between Indic and Non-Indic Contextual General Reasoning in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (using standard generation metrics like BLEU, ROUGE, BERTScore, and LLM-as-a-judge GEval) on zero-shot entity and rationale prediction tasks across two distinct subsets of a custom open-domain quiz benchmark (QUENCH): one featuring Indic (Indian) cultural and geographical contexts, and another featuring Non-Indic (Western/Global) contexts.
